66:         private set

69:     var onClipboardReceivedListener: ((nodeId: String, text: String) -> Unit)? = null

80:     private val meshesMap = ConcurrentHashMap<String, MeshGroup>()
81:     private val nodesMap = ConcurrentHashMap<String, MeshNode>()
82: 
83:     fun getNodeMeshId(nodeId: String): String {
84:         val cleanId = nodeId.removePrefix("node//").removePrefix("node/").trim()
85:         val node = nodesMap[cleanId] ?: nodesMap["node//$cleanId"]
86:         val meshId = node?.meshid ?: ""
87:         return meshId.removePrefix("mesh//").removePrefix("mesh/").trim()
88:     }
89: 
90:     // Emits list of groups mapped to their nodes, sorted alphabetically by group name.
91:     // Within each group, nodes are sorted with Online nodes FIRST, then Offline nodes.
92:     private val _groupedDevices = MutableStateFlow<List<Pair<MeshGroup, List<MeshNode>>>>(emptyList())
93:     val groupedDevices: StateFlow<List<Pair<MeshGroup, List<MeshNode>>>> = _groupedDevices.asStateFlow()
94: 
95:     fun extractRawToken(cookie: String): String {
96:         for (part in cookie.split(";")) {
97:             val trimmed = part.trim()
98:             if (trimmed.startsWith("xid=") || trimmed.startsWith("x-mesh-auth=") || trimmed.startsWith("auth=")) {
99:                 val token = trimmed.substringAfter("=")
100:                 if (token.startsWith("eyJ")) return token
101:             }
102:         }
103:         for (part in cookie.split(";")) {
104:             val token = part.trim().substringAfter("=")
105:             if (token.startsWith("eyJ")) return token
106:         }
107:         val first = cookie.split(";")[0].trim()
108:         return if (first.contains("=")) first.substringAfter("=") else first
109:     }
110: 
111:     fun login(
112:         rawServerUrl: String,
113:         username: String,
114:         pass: String,
115:         otpToken: String = "",
116:         ignoreSslCert: Boolean = false,
117:         onResult: (AuthResult) -> Unit
118:     ) {
119:         val cleanUrl = OkHttpHelper.sanitizeServerUrl(rawServerUrl)
120:         serverUrl = cleanUrl
121:         ignoreSsl = ignoreSslCert
122:         val client = OkHttpHelper.createClient(ignoreSslCert)
123:         okHttpClient = client
124: 
125:         scope.launch {
126:             try {
127:                 val formBodyBuilder = FormBody.Builder()
128:                     .add("username", username)
129:                     .add("password", pass)
130: 
131:                 if (otpToken.isNotBlank()) {
132:                     formBodyBuilder.add("vtoken", otpToken)
133:                     formBodyBuilder.add("otptoken", otpToken)
134:                     formBodyBuilder.add("token", otpToken)
135:                 }
136: 
137:                 val request = Request.Builder()
138:                     .url("$cleanUrl/login")
139:                     .post(formBodyBuilder.build())
177:                 }
178:             } catch (e: Exception) {
179:                 onResult(AuthResult.Error("Error de conexión: ${e.localizedMessage ?: "No se pudo contactar al servidor"}"))
180:             }
181:         }
182:     }
183: 
184:     private val controlRetries=ControlRetry(scope,controlGeneration,
185:         shouldConnect={ !isUserLogout && controlConfigValid && serverUrl.isNotBlank() && authCookie.isNotBlank() && !_connectionState.value && !controlConnecting },
186:         connect={ connectControlSocket(serverUrl,authCookie,ignoreSsl) },
187:         onError={
188:             controlConnecting=false
189:             _connectionState.value=false
190:             _connectionStatus.value=ConnectionStatus.CONNECTING
191:             Log.e("MeshCentralClient","Cannot start control connection (${it.javaClass.simpleName})")
192:         })
193:     @Volatile var isUserLogout: Boolean = false
194: 
195:     fun reconnectNow() { controlRetries.request(true) }
